steps.en: Prepare runtime, model profiles and isolation tools
steps.zh: 准备运行环境、模型配置与隔离工具

steps.en: Create a benchmark and replace demonstration tasks and scoring
steps.zh: 创建评测项目，替换示例任务与评分

steps.en: Check a seed trial and start one optimization round
steps.zh: 检查单任务试跑，再启动一轮优化

steps.en: Propose candidate resource edits and evaluate sealed versions
steps.zh: 提出资源改动，评测固定候选版本

steps.en: Apply the configured acceptance gate and retain an accepted champion
steps.zh: 执行配置的验收闸门，保留获准版本

value.en: An edit is tied to comparable task evidence, not a remembered impression
value.zh: 用可比任务证据判断改动，不靠记忆中的印象
